abilities.name: Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost
_curatorNotes: Variants above are pre-existing display variants from the generator showing infusion duration (talent-scaling, 2.0–3.0s) and field duration (10s). Field entity lifetime is now canonical on summons[0]. Infusion duration (infuseDur[talentLevel]) is applied as a stat modifier on characters within the field on each tick — not a separate summon entity.

Field ticks every 60 frames from skillHitmark (frame 36) through expiry at frame 636 (skillHitmark + 600). Each tick checks if active character is within the field area and applies cryo infusion + A1 ATK SPD buff for infuseDur seconds. This is a proc mechanic, not a persistent aura — reviewer to decide effect representation.
A6 rigor 2026-07-12: Infusion variant duration corrected 2.8 → 2.9 (talent-level-10 value; sidecar Infusion Duration col 10 = 2.9s, gcsim infuseDur[9]=2.9). Was the level-9 value.

Infusion authored 2026-10-12 (Nate approved): Candace’s shape — target active, sword/claymore/polearm. gcsim re-infuses the active character every 60f while inside the field (600f from the 36f hitmark), each lasting infuseDur (2.9s at talent level 10), so the honest window is 0.6 + 10 + 2.9 = 13.5s from the cast. Anchored at the cast (no start-delay field), so the first 0.6s is an over-claim before the field forms. Settles the representation question noted above.
abilities.description:
Chongyun strikes the ground with his greatsword, causing a Cryo explosion in a circular AoE in front of him that deals Cryo DMG.
After a short delay, the cold air created by the Cryo explosion will coalesce into a Chonghua Frost Field, within which all Sword, Claymore and Polearm-wielding characters' weapons will be infused with Cryo.
abilities.caveat: Assumes the active character stays inside the Frost Field; in play the infusion lasts only 2.9s after they leave it.

constellations.name: Ice Unleashed
constellations.description: The last attack of Chongyun's Normal Attack combo releases 3 ice blades. Each blade deals 50% of Chongyun's ATK as Cryo DMG to all opponents in its path.
_curatorNotes: ↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/rounds/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C1 — Ice Unleashed — effects[0] (damage 50% atk, cryo) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `internal/characters/chongyun/attack.go:68-94` — on `NormalCounter == 3` (N4) at Cons ≥ 1, three `AttackTagNone` / `ICDTagNone` Cryo hits (Durability 25 = 1U each, Mult 0.5) queue at `attackHitmarks[3] + 0/5/10`. ⚠️ Not in `cons.go` at all — the host's curator note says "gcsim cons.go", which is wrong. Retained: N4-only (`NormalCounter == 3`), three blades at hitmark +0/+5/+10 frames, 50% ATK each, Cryo at Durability 25, `ICDTagNone` — so at C1 every N4 lands three extra Cryo applications the aura lane does not draw. Correct the note's "gcsim cons.go" to `attack.go:68`. ⚠️ The only shape that would reach a pixel is a `damage` effect carrying `application[]` on an `onHit` trigger, and that has no arming path: `sim/procs.ts` arms an ability-hosted listener only from a CAST with `trigger.armedFor` (`armCastProcs`, procs.ts:216-232) or from a summon (`armSummonProcs`). A constellation-hosted, permanently-armed swing listener is neither, and `armedFor` on it would be a fabricated window. Re-triggering without `application[]` buys nothing — a `damage` effect draws no bar, no marker and no TB row.
